environment.description: Deployed on EKS with Pod Security Standard 'restricted' profile enforced at namespace level via PodSecurity admission controller. Container spec sets securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volume mounts defined in the pod spec (volumeMounts array is empty). The container runtime (containerd with default snapshotter) propagates the ro mount flag to all overlay layers. CONFIG_PATH environment variable is set to /app/config/runtime.json but no writable mount exists at that path. Additionally, the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy for this namespace restricts ingress to only port 8080 from the ingress-nginx namespace with label app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx, and the NGINX ingress has a snippet annotation limiting request body size to 1KB on the /api/config path.
